objective: Evaluate the 512-MiB cross-query minimax choice selected on 2009 without retuning on 2010 or 2011.

policy.selection_rule: minimum worst observed median regret across 2009 common and variable-width queries
policy.heldout_acceptance: selected candidate regret no greater than 10% relative to the best comparator median in each held-out episode/query cell

design.order: seeded randomized complete blocks containing both epochs
design.warmup: one 512-MiB query per episode/query before measured blocks

primary_analysis: For each held-out episode/query, calculate selected-candidate median regret against the best of 128/512/2048/4096 MiB.
Report paired block log-ratio effects and exact sign-flip p-values versus 512 MiB with Holm correction within each episode/query family.
Report block-bootstrap median intervals without treating them as simultaneous equivalence bands.
Do not change the selected candidate after examining validation_2010.
safety: No retry, split-retry, spill, failed task, or executor loss.
If a safety event occurs, the transfer criterion fails for that cell.
limitations: The two held-out epochs belong to the same taxi table and host.
Variable-width physical representation changes in 2011 and is handled by the existing explicit read/cast adapter.
Five paired blocks cannot achieve two-sided exact sign-flip p below 0.0625.
Passing does not validate other codecs, clusters, or query families.
